focus.name: actor-collision-type23-pair-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the Type-0x23 collision-response pair builder and its zero-template/source-position helper to stable actor-collision identities.

targets.name: ActorCollision_SpawnType23ResponsePair
targets.contract: Convert the source actor to Type-0x84, create a Type-0x3B zero-template companion at the source position when a slot is available, then initialize a second Type-0x84 collision-template actor from the source coordinates.

targets.name: ActorCollision_SpawnZeroTemplateAtSourcePosition
targets.contract: Initialize the destination from ACTOR_TEMPLATE_BASE_ZERO and copy source actor offsets +0x02/+0x04 into the destination position fields.

contracts: The Type-0x23 response pair is entered only through the existing player-collision activation path when PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD is nonzero.
The pair builder retains the exact Type-0x84 source conversion, Type-0x3B companion animation, second Type-0x84 collision template, source-position copy, and free-slot failure behavior.
The helper has a separate non-overlapping function boundary and owns only the zero-template initialization and source-position copy.
evidence: Exact function boundaries and established Type-0x23 collision contracts
limitations: The names identify the collision-response allocation roles, not the user-facing interaction that triggers them.
The pair's dynamic actor lifetime after allocation remains governed by the existing collision and AnimationVM services.
